title: Result dataset title
rangeHelp: Use a contiguous range in the retained source-row order. Source positions start at 1; they are row numbers, not inferred times.
parameterHelp: Supply the target and threshold explicitly. The target, allowance, threshold and converted source readings share this declared difference-unit coordinate system.
conventions: Both scores begin at zero. Upper: max(0, previous upper + reading - target - k). Lower: max(0, previous lower + target - reading - k). A threshold entry occurs when a score becomes strictly greater than h after being at or below h.
noInference: Threshold entries do not assign significance, probability, or a physical change time. Accumulation starts describe contributing source rows, not inferred change onset.
afterSignal-reset-both-after-row: Reset both after retaining this row
gapHelp: A reset gap remains visible as a missing or excluded row. Its score and start values are unavailable, not zero.
afterSignalHelp: When a threshold entry resets both accumulations, the current row keeps its calculated scores and entry flags; the next row starts from zero.
executionBounds: Each numerical slice must fit the maximum operations and milliseconds of the exact resource policy.
executionInvalid: The numerical slice exceeds the exact resource policy. Adjust the slice or explicitly revise that resource policy. Your entries are retained.
invalid: Choose a scalar signal, a positive source-row count, an explicit target and threshold, a difference unit and valid saved resource limits. Your entries are retained.
busy: CUSUM operation in progress. Please wait.
previewNote: The complete selected range is processed. This preview shows at most five rows; retain the result to read every score and threshold entry.
previewTruncated: A preview scalar is shortened. The retained result preserves the complete value.
savedHelp: Reapplying creates a result revision. Earlier results keep their source revision and complete method declaration.
repeatFromDataset: Open the retained result dataset to reapply its pinned CUSUM recipe.
publicContext: {method}; {role}; {count} source rows. Target {target}; allowance k {allowance}; threshold h {threshold}. {conventions} {gaps} {afterSignal} {unit} {execution} {interpretation}
publicConventions: Retained source order; both scores initially zero; threshold entry requires score strictly greater than h after being at or below h.
publicGaps-reject: Missing or excluded rows refuse calculation.
publicGaps-reset-both: Missing or excluded rows reset both accumulations and retain unavailable scores.
publicAfter-continue: Both accumulations continue after a threshold entry.
publicAfter-reset-both-after-row: A threshold entry resets both accumulations after retaining that row.
publicInterpretation: Positions are original source row numbers starting at 1, not inferred times. Accumulation starts identify contributing row extents; no significance, probability or physical onset is inferred.
publicRole-source-position: original source row number starting at 1
publicRole-upper-crossing: upper threshold entry flag (1 means entry; 0 means no entry)
publicRole-lower-crossing: lower threshold entry flag (1 means entry; 0 means no entry)
publicRole-upper-start: original source row where the current upper accumulation starts
publicRole-lower-start: original source row where the current lower accumulation starts
publicRole-status: source treatment: value, missing or excluded
publicRole-reset-after: both accumulations reset after this row (1 means reset; 0 means no reset)
sourceUnitHelp: The signal column must declare a compatible difference-unit definition with zero offset. A unit label alone does not define a conversion.
